Compared with original, definately a new edit. Via Redditor spence-cake: 

- Has a 30-second long loopy intro absent on the original 12”
- Omits the 2nd half of each verse
- Omits all oooh oooh’s
- Omits the bridge where the melody is inverted
- Skips the 3rd verse entirely and goes straight to the 4th verse
- Omits the bridge right before the breakdown
- Entire breakdown is reworked, possibly with some added whooshes, percussion, and delay effects (the last of which may have been done in the booth)
- Impossible to tell based on the recording from last Sunday, but in general it feels like a lot of low end and oomph has been added

Overall, a masterclass in disco editing.
Grade-A work, 10 out of 10.
